_comment: Protocol base for TARGET=sepolia. Read by deploy/vault-service.sh, deploy/enter-loop.sh and deploy/sepolia-setup.sh. Every field is real onchain state: Ethena's canonical Sepolia USDe, Circle's canonical Sepolia USDC, Morpho's Ethereum Sepolia Morpho Blue + AdaptiveCurveIRM + ChainlinkOracleV2Factory, plus the MorphoChainlinkOracleV2 and Morpho market our own deploy/sepolia-setup.sh created on 2026-09-09 (tx signer 0x03F3c4B41d839846A13841506297a567a3ebBa7a). Downstream scripts must read from here, not hardcode.

chain._comment: Ethereum Sepolia. Chain id, block time and gas semantics come from the target file (targets/sepolia.json); this block only pins the source data the deploy inherits from the parent live chain.

usde._comment: Ethena's canonical Ethereum Sepolia USDe. Real ERC-20, 18 decimals, verified on Sepolia Etherscan. On mainnet Ethena runs the same shape at 0x4c9EDD5852cd905f086C759E8383e09bff1E68B3; the Sepolia deployment is their designated testnet counterpart.
usde.provenance: docs.ethena.fi/resources/testnet (Ethereum Sepolia entry); symbol()+decimals() read on-chain

usdc._comment: Circle's canonical Ethereum Sepolia USDC. Real ERC-20, 6 decimals, minted from https://faucet.circle.com/.

morpho._comment: Real Morpho contracts on Ethereum Sepolia. Different addresses from the Base and Ethereum mainnet deployments (Morpho does not vanity-deploy on Sepolia); cross-checked against docs.morpho.org/developers/contracts/addresses (Sepolia tab).
morpho.blue_provenance: docs.morpho.org addresses page (Sepolia tab); code confirmed on Sepolia Etherscan
morpho.chainlink_oracle_v2_factory_provenance: docs.morpho.org addresses page (Sepolia tab). This factory is what sepolia-setup.sh calls to mint a MorphoChainlinkOracleV2 pointing at four address(0) feed slots; MorphoChainlinkOracleV2's own logic collapses that configuration to a hardcoded 1:1 rate scaled by SCALE_FACTOR (= 1e24 for 18-decimals collateral against 6-decimals loan), i.e. the exact same shape as the mainnet USDe/USDC market's own oracle.

market._comment: PERMISSIONLESS MARKET CREATED BY US on 2026-09-09 via deploy/sepolia-setup.sh. Marketparams = (loan=USDC, collateral=USDe, oracle=our 1:1 stub, irm=AdaptiveCurve, lltv=91.5%). Read this block, do not re-derive.
market.provenance: Created by deploy/sepolia-setup.sh on Ethereum Sepolia, block observed via https://sepolia.etherscan.io/address/0xd011EE229E7459ba1ddd22631eF7bF528d424A14 (idToMarketParams call returns the four addresses + 91.5% LLTV verbatim). Same market id is committed as USDE_USDC_MORPHO_SEPOLIA in packages/loop-deploy/src/catalog.ts.

swap_route._comment: USDC -> USDe swap venue for the loop entry leg. There is no committed liquid Sepolia USDC/USDe pool - Sepolia testnet DEX liquidity is thin. Two paths: (a) seed a Uniswap V3 USDC/USDe pool ourselves (Uniswap V3 factory on Sepolia is 0x0227628f3F023bb0B980b67D528571c95c6DaC1c, SwapRouter02 is 0x3fC91A3afd70395Cd496C647d5a6CC9D4B2b7FAD; cost is ~2000 USDe minted + ~2000 USDC swapped) or (b) run a no-loop demo (the vault supplies USDC to Morpho directly, no swap needed, weaker pitch but zero DEX setup). Left blank pending decision.

service._comment: Same NAV computation inputs as the fork - the strategy is the strategy either way. twap_window_secs bounds the pool TWAP the collateral pricing floor reads; inputs_block_lag is how far behind head the component pins its reads (NAV-03). Sepolia has ~12s blocks so a 2-block lag is one 24s reorg window; keep the mainnet-shape number here.

deploy_params._comment: Same strategy parameters as the fork - see fork.config.json for the derivation. Copied here rather than inherited so a testnet-only tweak (e.g. reducing initial_deposit_usdc to keep the demo wallet's faucet balance from getting drained) does not touch the fork's numbers.
